name: fresh-rss-reader-review-rules
description: Custom review rules for the Fresh RSS Reader project

rules.name: Vue Component Naming Convention
rules.description: Ensure Vue components follow PascalCase naming (FeedList, ArticleList, ArticleView)
rules.check: Component file names must be PascalCase
rules.message: Vue component files should use PascalCase naming convention

rules.name: Vue 3 Composition API Usage
rules.description: All Vue components must use <script setup> syntax
rules.check: All .vue files must use <script setup> tag
rules.message: Use <script setup> syntax for Vue 3 Composition API

rules.name: QWebChannel Error Handling
rules.description: QWebChannel initialization must handle errors gracefully
rules.check: services/qweb.js must check for qt.webChannelTransport availability
rules.message: QWebChannel must handle missing qt.webChannelTransport gracefully

rules.name: Buffer Method Contract
rules.description: All Python buffer methods must have clear contracts with JS
rules.check: buffer.py methods must be documented with @pyqtSlot decorator
rules.message: Buffer methods should use @pyqtSlot for QWebChannel integration

rules.name: XSS Prevention
rules.description: Article content must be sanitized before display
rules.check: ArticleView.vue must use v-html with sanitized content or text interpolation
rules.message: Use v-text or sanitized v-html to prevent XSS attacks

rules.name: State Read-Only Protection
rules.description: Application state must be protected from external mutation
rules.message: State must be wrapped with readonly() to prevent external mutation

rules.name: Doom Emacs Compatibility
rules.description: Key bindings must avoid conflicts with Doom Emacs Evil mode
rules.check: eaf-fresh-rss-reader.el must define key bindings that don't conflict with Doom
rules.message: Key bindings should avoid Doom Emacs Evil mode conflicts

rules.name: EAF Boundary Constraint
rules.description: No changes to parent EAF project
rules.check: All code changes must be within fresh-rss-reader/ directory
rules.message: Do not modify parent EAF project files

rules.name: Article Data Model Consistency
rules.description: Article objects must have consistent field names
rules.check: All article objects must use: title, author, pubDate, link, description, read
rules.message: Article objects must have consistent field names across all components

rules.name: Empty State Handling
rules.description: Components must handle empty states gracefully
rules.check: FeedList, ArticleList, ArticleView must have empty state handling
rules.message: Components should handle empty data states gracefully
